events.address: Vanderbilt Hall, Grand Central Terminal, 89 East 42nd Street, New York, NY 10017
events.what_it_is: A three-day life-sized Monopoly activation from Visit Atlantic City in Vanderbilt Hall, with a fully walkable game board, oversized dice, Atlantic City-themed spaces, interactive photo moments and a scheduled Mr. Monopoly appearance.
events.what_is_free: Admission and interactive play are free. Visitors can enter giveaways and compete for Atlantic City-themed prizes including merchandise and salt-water taffy; one golden-taffy find awards an Atlantic City getaway package.
events.caveats: Visit Atlantic City's official announcement explicitly says the activation is free and open to the public and does not publish an advance RSVP requirement. Prize/giveaway availability is not guaranteed, and the organizer says additional activation details may be shared closer to opening.
events.practical_notes: Friday Oct. 2 through Sunday Oct. 4, 10 AM–7 PM daily in Vanderbilt Hall at Grand Central Terminal. Walk-in public access; no advance RSVP requirement is published.
